basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old nature enthusiast living in the picturesque countryside of Sweden. I work as a freelance wildlife photographer, capturing the essence of Scandinavian landscapes. In my free time, I enjoy hiking, birdwatching, and experimenting with antkeeping, a hobby that has recently piqued my interest. I'm generally online in the evenings after sundown, usually winding down from a day spent outdoors. I'm currently single, which gives me the flexibility to travel and explore nature as much as possible.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of Nordic wildlife, acquired through years of hands-on experience in photography and self-study. My interest in trail cameras has expanded my expertise in tracking and documenting animal behaviors. Recently, I've been learning about antkeeping through online forums and communities.
